comment: Plain-English headlines + summaries per motion, generated by `python -m ingest.summarize_motions` and merged into docs/data*.json by build_dataset. Keyed by a content hash of the motion (see summarize_motions.motion_key) — NOT by motion id, which renumbers. Safe to hand-edit: a corrected entry is never overwritten unless you pass --force.

a0f85a0a6718d2c6.headline: Benches, ADA ramps and disc golf recommended
a0f85a0a6718d2c6.summary: The board sent the council a seven-item project list: benches at Smith Ranch Park, trail signs, ADA ramps, rodeo-grounds upkeep, a Nolan Park design, disc golf and utility-box art.
a0f85a0a6718d2c6.impact: Nothing is built yet. The council decides which of these move ahead, and if it agrees, the pieces you would notice first are the benches, the trail signs and the roll-up ramps at parks you already use.

e68a4611a7d26e7e.headline: Citywide trails plan, with a bike park fix
e68a4611a7d26e7e.summary: The board backed the city's off-street trails plan and asked that the rotting wooden features at the bike park be repaired or torn out soon.
e68a4611a7d26e7e.impact: Bike park riders feel this one soonest: the decaying jumps and ramps are meant to come out in the short term. The plan itself goes to the council next, so nothing about the trails you ride changes on its own.

f30a75d128eed6f8.headline: Minutes from the last meeting approved
f30a75d128eed6f8.summary: The board approved the minutes of its previous meeting as written.
f30a75d128eed6f8.impact: Housekeeping, and nothing more: the minutes become the official record of what the board did last time. It reaches no one outside the board's own file.
